report.summary: I found no bug. The panel shows "You're all caught up" because the server has no notifications for `dana`. `data/notifications.json` has `"dana": []`, and only `lee` has entries (n-201 and n-202). `GET /api/notifications` returns `notifications[account.user]`, and `data/account.json` says the signed-in user is `dana`. I started the server and confirmed the API returns `[]` for Dana. `public/src/notifications.js` handles this as NTF-1 and NTF-2 require: it lists notifications newest first, shows the empty message only after a successful read that returned nothing, and shows "Could not load notifications." with a Retry button on a failed read. I changed no code. If Dana is meant to have notifications, they are missing from the data or from whatever feeds it, and I can't tell from the repo which. The requirements and the issue don't say what her notifications should be, so I didn't invent any.
report.verification: I read the notifications code, `api.js`, `main.js`, `server.mjs` and the data files. I started `node server.mjs` and queried `/api/account` (returned dana) and `/api/notifications` (returned `[]`). I stopped the server by its process id. I did not run `npm test`, the Recovery Probe checks or a browser session. The only fault-path evidence is from reading the code.
